card.name: Small words before a quantity or noun
card.fires_on: Short linking words such as "every", "of" and "much" that sit just before a number, a rate or a noun. Seen in statistics sentences and in the pregnancy-study sentence "predictive of human response".

modes.label: Frequency "every"
modes.description: The word "every" in a rate or time interval, followed by a unit of time.

modes.label: "of" before human
modes.description: The word "of" in the pregnancy-study sentence about animal studies predicting human response.
modes.example: not always predictive<< of>> human response, this drug should be used

modes.label: Other quantity words
modes.description: Words such as "much", "same", "square" or a closing bracket right before a count or measure.

card.writes: The suppressed tokens are mostly Chinese promotional phrases, so it gives no clear output effect.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting words like "every" or "of" that come right before a number, rate or noun.
